artist.name: Loote
artist.place_of_origin: New York City, New York, United States
artist.short_description: Loote — an Afterglow curated emotional-pop discovery profile.
artist.biography: Loote is a New York-associated American pop duo built around the songwriting and production partnership of Emma Lov and Jackson Foote. According to AllMusic, the pair met while studying and continued making music together after a class project; their work brings producer-minded arrangement into a vocal pop setting. Their recorded catalogue includes the 2017 single ‘High Without Your Love,’ the 2018 collection ‘single.’ and the 2019 EP ‘lost.’ Apple Music lists the duo’s tracks ‘Your Side of the Bed,’ ‘tomorrow tonight,’ ‘she’s all yours’ and ‘Wish I Never Met You’ among its featured catalogue selections. Their collaborative approach also reached outside their own releases. A 2019 Ones to Watch feature documents ‘85%’ with gnash and describes the track as a vocal duet addressing unequal effort in a relationship. The song is particularly relevant to Afterglow’s interest in bittersweet emotional songwriting presented through bright pop production. Loote also appears on ‘Better When You’re Gone’ alongside David Guetta and Brooks, reflecting a connection to dance-pop. Their 2026 single ‘This Is the Last Song About You’ is credited jointly with Anson Seabra, creating a direct bridge to another artist in Afterglow’s research catalogue. Loote’s combination of polished hooks, electronic textures, and personal relationship narratives makes them a strong addition to the site’s more energetic emotional-pop category.
